item.title: The agent was never alone: SIMEA
item.description: Classical economics models the agent as a rational maximiser; behavioural economics keeps the maximiser and catalogues its failures. SIMEA starts elsewhere: the agent as a decision subject, embedded in and steered by systems. Three measurable constructs, and a second paper on why determinism does not imply predictability.
